coverage_target: High practical coverage of reusable SAP S/4HANA Sales process patterns. Localizations and narrow industry variants are mapped as aliases or adjacent capabilities unless they change a core business/control contract.
decision_rules: Separate a variant when it changes physical flow, stock ownership, supply source, legal entity, inspection/disposition, billing trigger, settlement model, product configuration, project/production cost object, or integration evidence.
Map a SAP scope item to an existing author code when it is mainly a packaged best-practice implementation of the same business contract.
Keep order origin, orchestration and downstream application ownership as separate graph classes instead of encoding every system combination into the process name.

scope_aliases.reason: non-stock item with order-specific procurement is the practical order-specific procurement branch
full Customer Returns / Advanced Returns Management pattern
payment overlays rather than new fulfillment branches
sales order processing for sales kits
sales order processing and billing for project-based services

distinct_candidates.title: Customer Returns for Material with Variant Configuration
distinct_candidates.why_distinct: AVC configuration is copied or maintained in the returns order, can affect pricing/output, and has release/deployment-specific limitations on replacement and follow-up activities.

distinct_candidates.title: Sales Order Processing with Customer Down Payment
distinct_candidates.why_distinct: SAP explicitly documents the milestone-billing down-payment process as functionally and technically distinct from newer Advanced Down Payment Processing (7S7/7Z1).

distinct_candidates.title: Engineer-to-Order for Complex Assembly / CTO+
distinct_candidates.why_distinct: Complex-assembly ETO adds order-specific engineering changes to product structures and production models beyond the basic project-stock ETO pattern.
